name: crapide-vscode
description: CRAP metric integration for VS Code and Cursor (bootstrap only)

virtualWorkspaces.description: CRAP analysis requires a file-backed workspace and an external CLI.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: CRAP analysis runs an external CLI and project tests.

scripts.format:check: prettier --check src test eslint.config.mjs .vscode-test.cjs package.json tsconfig.json
scripts.format: prettier --write src test eslint.config.mjs .vscode-test.cjs package.json tsconfig.json
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check
